title: 短裤上班支持率：仅45%，办公室着装会否松动？

segments.en: He not proposing that shorts be allowed in the workplace but investigating whether or not there's an appetite for it and Chris took Christina's point. You did this in a very data-driven way.
segments.zh: 他并不是提议允许在职场穿短裤，而是调查是否有这种需求。Chris采纳了Christina的观点，你以数据驱动的方式做了这件事。

segments.en: market pull surveys, analysts and terminal subscribers and 45% of people, 45% not a majority, that it was suitable to wear shorts to work. Now some of these people responded and said,
segments.zh: 分析师和终端订阅者中，45%的人认为穿短裤上班合适，但这不是多数。现在有些人回应说，如果你在冲浪店工作，那当然可以。人们真的不支持穿短裤上班。

segments.en: yeah, of course it's okay if you work at a surf shop. People really do not support wearing shorts work. However, I believe it's time. You believe it's time. You're going to take that position.
segments.zh: 然而，我相信现在是时候了。你相信是时候了。你会采取那个立场。

segments.en: I work near you physically in the office. You often do wear shorts in the summer. You've been taking the stand for a while before you put pen to paper. I want you to go back to when you first did it.
segments.zh: 我在办公室里离你很近。你夏天经常穿短裤。你在动笔之前就已经坚持这个立场一段时间了。我想让你回到你第一次穿短裤的时候。

segments.en: Were you apprehensive about it? What did you think the reaction was going to be?
segments.zh: 你当时有顾虑吗？你预想会有什么反应？
